signatures: pub struct Limits { pub max_output_bytes: u32 }
impl Default for Limits: max_output_bytes = i32::MAX as u32
pub fn apply(source: &[u8], delta: &[u8], limits: Limits) -> Result<Vec<u8>, DeltaError>
api.limit_rule: Apply effective ceiling min(i32::MAX, caller max_output_bytes). Caller limit is explicit; CLI uses i32::MAX with no smaller hidden cap. output_size only parses header; can return full u32 to let caller inspect. Apply rejects source/delta input lengths above i32::MAX to remain within C signed-length envelope; explicit InputTooLarge, not cast/wrap.
api.error_contract: Typed library variants stable for focused tests; offsets are byte indices. No checksum mismatch variant needed in disabled-checksum leaf. No syntax error for empty numeric fields, numeric wrap or trailing bytes. AllocationFailed retains actual TryReserveError and std::error::Error::source returns it; typed I/O adapter errors retain std::io::Error likewise. Display is presentation only, never the storage of causes. Do not require Clone/Eq on complete DeltaError because allocation cause may not support them; tests match variant/fields and inspect source chain.

parsing: parse_uint consumes only custom alphabet digits; initial value0; wrapping_shl(6)/wrapping_add digit on u32. Empty digit sequence yields0 and consumes nothing. No sign/whitespace handling.
Header must be followed by actual LF. Parse wrapped u32 first, then apply ceiling; do not limit digit count or reject overflow.
At command start NUL or end before semicolon is Unterminated. Literal payload can contain NUL and arbitrary bytes. Semicolon terminates immediately, ignores checksum value and every trailing byte.
Copy consumes count, @, offset, comma. Count0 copies zero; require offset<=source length even when count0. Require comma byte present, not merely accessible sentinel.
Widen u32 values to u64 for cumulative length/source-range comparisons, then checked usize conversion/addition and safe slice get. Never wrap addresses or output totals. No unsafe pointer emulation.
allocation_algorithm: First allocation-free validate pass over immutable slices: header/input/explicit limits, every source and literal range, cumulative output size, terminator and exact final size. Do not collect operation vector. Return malformed error before reserving advertised output.

Only after complete validation create Vec and try_reserve_exact(advertised as usize). Map error retaining original TryReserveError in AllocationFailed { requested, source }; implement Error::source. Replay immutable bytes through checked safe slices into reserved Vec. Zero output can skip reservation.

Two passes intentionally avoid C wrapper eager giant allocations for invalid short deltas while preserving defined decode results. Error ordering is library contract above, not claimed C internal equivalence. No NUL output terminator is needed in Vec.

ub_boundary: C copy delimiter check only rejects noncomma when lenDelta>0; end-of-buffer offset can advance pointer beyond logical end (delta.c:607-611). It may rely on Blob sentinel/pointer representation. Rust requires present comma and returns safe truncation; observed copy-truncated-offset already rejected. Do not emulate pointer arithmetic UB or claim arbitrary C UB inputs define a format.

C wrapper signed-length narrowing/allocation overflow is outside supported input envelope. Rust explicit i32 length/output ceilings and checked address math define safe failure. u32 numeric wrapping itself is defined and preserved.
C output pointer terminator write and allocator failures do not require Rust unsafe buffers or crash matching. Finite observed no-crash corpus is evidence for those bytes only.

numeric_lookup_exact.index_type: unsigned char *z; full byte0..255 indexes a256-entry signed-char table; NO &0x7f mask. Entries128..255 all -1.
numeric_lookup_exact.semantics: Consumes ASCII custom alphabet only. Invalid/high-bit byte stays unconsumed. Empty numeric field0 is allowed only if following caller delimiter/operator then permits it. Header LF, copy comma, and operator characters are exact raw ASCII, not masked. High-bit payload literal/copied bytes remain ordinary bytes.
numeric_lookup_exact.sentinel: getInt checks z<zEnd before lookup; no sentinel read needed. Apply command loop tests length>0 before current byte, and command dispatch checks remaining>0. Copy delimiter branch is anomalous when offset ends exactly at end: C skips noncomma rejection then increments beyond logical end. Blob NUL sentinel exists for C strings; it is not a supplied delimiter and cannot justify Rust accepting missing comma or unsafe beyond-end pointers. Rust returns safe truncation/rejection, no speculative read.
